**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause.** `dep-4471` (a.novak, gateway, 02:12–02:14 UTC) flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`, applied as config generation 119 at 02:13:41. That capped the pool at its fixed size of 20 with no reuse, and it saturated 33 seconds later.

**Impact window.** First 503 at `02:14:18 UTC`, 2026-03-14 (`req-07401`, pool `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, size 20/in_use 20). Still failing at the last log line, `03:59:27 UTC` — not yet resolved. `waiting` queue climbed steadily the whole time, from 13 up into the 70s–80s.

**Scope.** Gateway only. Every real route hit it — `/v1/cart`, `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/orders`, `/v1/catalog/search` — but `/health` kept returning 200 the whole time, so the process itself never died. `worker.log` is clean for the same window: one unrelated pre-existing slow-query warning (`OPS-2210`), no errors.

**Rollback.** Revert `dep-4471` — set `gateway.pool.perRequest` back to `false` (or raise pool size if perRequest is wanted long-term). No other deploy in that window is implicated.
